messages:
Omar Li: Quick thread for IntegratePro launch on June 30. We need final SI co-sell rules: lead ownership window, attribution window, demo-credit reconciliation, and consent language for data shares. Keep it simple and automatable.

Hannah Brooks: Proposal: IntegratePro gets an exclusive claim period of 7 calendar days. During that window they must mark claim + contact within 48h. If they fail to contact -> lead returns to Redwood pool.

Victor Chen: Add an attribution window for revenue credit: SI gets full credit for deals closed that convert within 90 days of their claim. If Redwood closes after 90d -> Redwood credit. Thoughts?

Priya Desai: Legal flag: must show explicit consent on market listing for sharing trial metrics with IntegratePro. Also need a data retention note in the playbook.

Omar Li: Agreed. Also we need a fair demo-credit flow: we give 3 demo credits per new marketplace lead. If SI claims, credits move to SI balance. If lead reverts to Redwood, unused credits revert. Need audit CSV for reconciliation.

Hannah Brooks: For SFDC & automation use canonical fields: lead_source=marketplace_integratepro, si_partner_id, si_claimed_ts, si_contacted_ts, si_attribution_expires_ts, demo_credits_allocated, demo_credits_used, consent_flag. We'll add a 'reassign_reason' enum for audit.

Victor Chen: Pseudocode for flows in the playbook:
```
on lead created:
  set lead_source = "marketplace_integratepro"
  allocate demo_credits = 3
  set reassign_at = created_at + 7d
on partner claim:
  set si_claimed_ts = now
  set si_attribution_expires_ts = now + 90d
  require si_contacted_ts within 48h else create escalation
on usage webhook:
  if usage_pct >= 50 -> set high_intent = true and cancel reassign
on reassign_at:
  if high_intent == false and si_contacted_ts == null -> reassign to Redwood and revert credits
```

Priya Desai: Also require the marketplace consent checkbox text: "I agree to share trial usage data with IntegratePro for the purposes of sales enablement and trial support." Must include link to data sharing policy.

Hannah Brooks: Who will build the SFDC flow and the demo-credit bookkeeping? We need a single owner for infra before launch.

Omar Li: @Victor can you own the SFDC flow and attribution logic? @Hannah can you own credit bookkeeping & reconciliation CSV spec?

Victor Chen: I can own SFDC flows. Will create a Jira and post the flow spec in Confluence. I'll include webhooks for partner usage events.

Hannah Brooks: I'll draft the CSV schema and a small reconciliation runbook. CSV export fields suggested: account_id, company, contact_email, lead_created_at, si_partner_id, si_claimed_ts, demo_credits_allocated, demo_credits_used, current_owner, reassign_reason.

LaunchOps Bot: Created ticket PART-11472: integratepro-marketplace-handoff (assignee: Victor Chen) - https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/PART-11472

Omar Li: Need to handle split-credit edgecases: if SI partially works a lead then drops before close, but they did documented POC steps, should we split credit? Suggest: documented engagement + <30d before close -> 50/50 split; else use attribution window rule. We'll formalize in the playbook.

Priya Desai: Legal OK with split-credit as long as we log engagement steps in CRM (notes + POC checklist) and partner agrees via playbook. Add checkbox for partner to accept split-credit terms during marketplace onboarding.

Victor Chen: I'll add a POC engagement checklist as a required field when SI marks claim: pocevidence_url, poc_start_ts, poc_steps_completed. That feeds into split-credit calculation.

Hannah Brooks: For operational sanity, schedule a weekly reconciliation job that outputs the CSV and flags mismatches for finance review. I'll own the first two weeks post-launch.

Omar Li: Final asks: Hannah update playbook with CSV + credit flow; Victor post SFDC flow spec & webhook contract; Priya post the exact consent text and retention policy; I'll sync with Marketing on co-branded assets. LaunchOps: confirm timeline.

LaunchOps Bot: Playbook review meeting scheduled Jun 22 9:30am PT. Invite sent.

Victor Chen: Will post the SFDC spec by EOD Tue.

Hannah Brooks: I'll drop the CSV spec and reconciliation playbook by Fri.

Priya Desai: I'll get consent text + retention details by Thu and loop Legal.

Omar Li: Thanks team. Once those pieces are in Confluence we'll loop IntegratePro for sign-off and lock the marketplace listing. :white_check_mark:
